Line 1: `zipEntry` is passed as a parameter to the method
Line 2: `tmp1 = zipEntry.getName()` - This uses zipEntry to get its name
Line 3: `String root = getRootName(tmp1)` - This uses tmp1 (which depends on zipEntry)
Line 11: `String name = mapper.map(getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()))` - This uses zipEntry.getName() again
Line 18: `File tmp2 = file.getParentFile()` - This creates tmp2 from the file path
Line 19: `FileUtils.forceMkdir(tmp2)` - This uses tmp2

The key dependency chain is:
- zipEntry.getName() is used at line 2 to create tmp1
- zipEntry.getName() is also used at line 11 to create name
- The file path is constructed using name (line 13: `new File(outputDir, name)`)
- tmp2 is derived from file.getParentFile() where file is created from the name
- Since name depends on zipEntry.getName(), and tmp2 is derived from the file path that uses name, tmp2 indirectly depends on zipEntry
